acceptance_oracle: On isolated PostgreSQL with current Alembic schema, kill a real product worker process after it claims a synthetic rescore operation; verify external readback sees the durable RUNNING claim, lease recovery returns it to QUEUED with its attempt and audit history, and a replacement worker completes attempt 2. Separately pause an original worker, recover and reclaim its expired lease from another Store engine, resume the stale worker, and prove it cannot publish the guarded side effect or overwrite the replacement claim.

acceptance.postgresql_process_kill_keeps_durable_ru: PASS - A separate worker process was killed after entering a synthetic DISCOVER rescore operation; PostgreSQL readback retained RUNNING and attempt_count=1.
acceptance.expired_lease_recovery_and_audit_survive: PASS - recover_expired changed the row to QUEUED/LEASE_EXPIRED; a new Store engine read one OPERATION_ATTEMPT_STARTED and one LEASE_RECOVERY audit event.
acceptance.replacement_worker_completes_next_attemp: PASS - A new worker process reclaimed the operation and persisted COMPLETED at attempt_count=2.
acceptance.stale_worker_attempt_is_fenced: PASS - After a replacement claim increments attempt_count, the paused original worker returned OWNERSHIP_EXPIRED, emitted no side effect, and left replacement state RUNNING at attempt_count=2.
acceptance.database_target_safety: PASS - Tests reject any non-loopback host or database name other than mjobs_worker_recovery; runtime was one disposable PostgreSQL 17 container bound only to 127.0.0.1.
